remarks: Step inside this incredible jewel box, just steps from the train, shops, & the vibrant Saugatuck restaurant scene. Originally built in 1860, this stunning home has been completely renovated with meticulous attention to detail, lending timeless charm with modern comfort. From the moment you step on to the wraparound porch, you are welcomed with warmth & character. Inside, the LR features shiplap walls, a cozy linear fireplace, floating walnut shelves; stylish sconces that create a relaxed inviting vibe. New hickory floors run throughout, connecting each space seamlessly. The DR showcases detailed ceiling work; a statement gallery feature, perfect for displaying art. Flooded with natural light, the kitchen is a dream for any home chef with vaulted ceiling and a smart, functional layout that balances beauty & practicality. The 1st floor primary suite is stylish and serene, with polished bath featuring a leaded art glass window, marble floors, steam shower with built in bench and a discreet laundry area. Upstairs are 2 additional bdrms & a well-appointed full bath with marble flooring. The attic, 233 sq. ft. not included in the listed sf, offers a cozy bonus space; ideal for exercise, an office or reading nook. The unfinished LL provides ample storage & utility including new built-in cabinets. Set on .63 level acres with landscaped grounds, the large private back yard includes a paver patio framed by stone walls and gas firepit. Move-in ready, close to all Westport has to offer!
